verdict.rationale: Bitbucket documents managing Jira issues inside its built-in Jira UI, with issue statuses updating automatically from commit keys. It also lets you open Jira tickets from the PR screen. The underlying tracker is the separate Jira product, though, and the only hint of native Bitbucket issue management is a single older community comment. Missing for 10: documented native issue tracking for bugs, features and requirements; labels; assignees; independent or hands-on corroboration of current issue-tracking depth.
